items.title: New Microsoft 365 Admin Feature Let Admins Control Link Creation Policies
items.description: Microsoft is rolling out a significant new administrative control feature in mid-September 2025 that will enable IT administrators to manage organization-wide sharing permissions for user-built Copilot agents. The feature addresses growing enterprise concerns about governance and security in AI agent deployment across organizations. Key Takeaways1. Microsoft is introducing a tenant-level feature…
